audience: email marketers who manage subscriber groups and newsletters in Sender.net

useCases.title: Count the subscribers in a group
useCases.text: List the subscriber groups with their counts. Then list the subscribers of one group.

useCases.title: Check the results of a sent campaign
useCases.text: List the campaigns, then read one campaign with its subject and status. Get its sent, open, click and unsubscribe counts.

useCases.title: Look up one subscriber
useCases.text: Get a subscriber by email address to read the status and group data. List the custom fields to see their names.

useCases.title: Add subscribers to a group without automations
useCases.text: Add a new subscriber, or add existing subscribers to a group. No email is sent unless automation is turned on.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft campaign for review
useCases.text: List the groups to find the target audience, then create a draft campaign. A person sends it in Sender.
